answers.genPolicy:e5e76049de0091dd0f40c55e414a32:
[B1] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
[B3] < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > $ deviceA 'uploadSecret' cloudA | (FreshSecret) .
[B3] < cloudA | deviceA : ('tickets' : ((FreshSecret, CurrentTime)) , ...) , ... > $ deviceA 'uploadSecret' cloudA | (FreshSecret)
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('tickets' : ((FreshSecret, CurrentTime), ...) , ...) , ... > .
[B4] < cloudA | deviceA : ('tickets' : ((Secret, Issued), ...) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'getKey' cloudA | (deviceA)
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('tickets' : ((Secret, Issued), ...) , ...) , ... > $ cloudA 'sendSecret' UserX | (Secret) if Issued == CurrentTime .
[B4] < UserX | 'knownSecrets' : Secrets , ... > $ cloudA 'sendSecret' UserX | (Secret)
=> < UserX | 'knownSecrets' : (Secrets, Secret) , ... > .
[B5] < UserX | 'knownSecrets' : (Secret, ...) , ... > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (deviceA ; Secret)
=> < UserX | 'knownSecrets' : (Secret, ...) , ... > .
[B5] < cloudA | deviceA : ('tickets' : ((Secret, Issued), ...) , 'owners' : nils , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (deviceA ; Secret)
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('tickets' : ((Secret, Issued), ...) , 'owners' : (UserX) , ...) , ... > .
[B6] < UserX | 'knownSecrets' : (Secret, ...) , ... > $ UserX 'join' cloudA | (deviceA ; Secret)
=> < UserX | 'knownSecrets' : (Secret, ...) , ... > .
[B6] < cloudA | deviceA : ('tickets' : ((Secret, Issued), ...) , 'owners' : (Owner, ...) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'join' cloudA | (deviceA ; Secret)
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('tickets' : ((Secret, Issued), ...) , 'owners' : (Owner, UserX, ...) , ...) , ... > .
[B7] < cloudA | deviceA : ('tickets' : ((Secret, Issued), ...) , ...) , ... >
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('tickets' : nils , ...) , ... > if CurrentTime - Issued > 2 .
